page.overview:
Who is Raymond?

Captain Raymond was a 24th century Starfleet officer who commanded the Federation starship and was recognized as one of the best officers in the fleet.

Raymond commanded the Tecumseh during the Cardassian wars, and later during the of 2372-2373.

In early 2373, Raymond commanded the Tecumseh, alongside the , in heading up the counterattack against the Klingon forces in the Archanis sector. ()
